svg.aria-label: CASM: Context-Aware Smart Asset Management. A MERN asset platform where files upload straight to AWS S3 through presigned URLs. Gemini generates metadata for each asset, which powers context-aware search. S3 presigned uploads, Gemini-generated metadata, Context-aware search.
